notes: Compound 1 of Grazioli et al. The measured values are those quoted in their Table 3; the primary papers are Mislow's. Deuterating the methyl groups (d6), the bridge CH2 groups (d4) or both (d10) speeds up racemization (inverse KIEs). The d2 rows put one deuterium on each bridge carbon, axial or equatorial; they were not measured. Their PyQuiverHS values (Bigeleisen-Mayer, no tunnelling) are given in the notes column.
